content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-284. - Approval of the finance director.
content.summary:
No license shall be issued by the city clerk unless and until such license is approved
               by the finance director or a duly authorized representative thereof.
(Code 1981, § 31-123; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
